items.title: RED: reproduce an unbounded repeat-block loop against a phase gate
items.context: Write a failing test that drives the same gate to refuse N times with an identical block reason (findings attributed to main agent, artifact=test-evidence.json) and asserts that some breaker stops it. It must fail today, proving no repeat-block detection exists. Model the reason on the B-4043 transcript evidence: 61 identical refusals against 54 re-review rounds.

happy.desc: gateFailureDigest(cmd, reasonA) vs gateFailureDigest(cmd, reasonB) where both reasons share identical first 200 normalized chars but differ at char 250 (e.g. different Diagnostic gaps list) -> both return the same digest key today (RED: proves .slice(0,200) truncation discards distinguishing content); WHY: reproduces the exact B-cc54 root cause at the unit level

bumpGateFailureCount called sequentially with 3 distinct ProofStory-style blockers (missing intent snapshot / missing acceptance binding / missing verificationIntentRefs) all sharing the invariant 200-char header -> maxGateFailureCount returns 3 on a single collapsed key instead of 1 per distinct key (RED: proves false counter inflation from digest collision); WHY: end-to-end consequence of the digest bug on the counter subsystem

edge.desc: gateFailureDigest with reason exactly 200 chars after normalization -> digest is stable; appending one distinguishing char at position 201 still produces the SAME digest (RED: boundary proof that .slice(0,200) discards char 201); WHY: boundary condition at the exact truncation point

adversarial.desc: Two reasons where raw text looks very different (mixed case, real /paths/to/files, real timestamps 2026-07-23T12:00:00Z, hex IDs a1b2c3d4e5f6) but normalization (lowercase + digits-># + paths-># + hex->#) makes first 200 chars identical while tails genuinely differ -> same digest despite semantically unrelated blockers; WHY: normalization amplifies the collision surface beyond naive identical-prefix construction

Three sequential bumpGateFailureCount with distinct real ProofStory blockers sharing the invariant header -> assessBreaker sees maxGateRepeat>=2 (threshold), first trip auto-recovers, counter rebuilds to >=2 again on fresh window -> freeze; isInteractiveAckAllowed returns false without TTY -> unattended run permanently stuck on a genuinely progressing story; WHY: proves the full end-to-end user-facing impact (token burn + permanent freeze) of the digest collision

items.title: Record consecutive identical gate blocks per story
items.context: Add a repeat-block ledger keyed on (storyId, gate, digest of the block reason). Increment on an identical consecutive block; reset when the gate passes or the block reason changes, so a genuinely progressing review is never penalised.

happy.desc: After fix, gateFailureDigest(cmd, reasonA) vs gateFailureDigest(cmd, reasonB) where both share the 200-char invariant ProofStory header but have different Diagnostic gaps tails -> produces two distinct digest keys; WHY: core fix verification -- different blockers must not collide

bumpGateFailureCount called with blocker-A twice then blocker-B once (all with shared header, different tails) -> maxGateFailureCount returns 2 (blocker-A count), not 3; WHY: counter correctly tracks per-distinct-key after digest fix

bumpGateFailureCount with genuinely identical reason 3 times -> maxGateFailureCount returns 3 and assessBreaker trips with gate-repeat; WHY: fix must not break detection of real infinite loops -- desirable collisions preserved

edge.desc: gateFailureDigest with reason >10KB containing many volatile tokens (absolute paths, ISO timestamps, hex IDs, bare numbers) -> normalization produces a stable deterministic key; same 10KB reason called twice returns identical digest; WHY: large-input stress + normalization idempotency
gateFailureDigest with empty reason string -> returns a valid non-empty digest key without throwing; WHY: null/empty input safety boundary

gateFailureDigest with two reasons that differ only by whitespace variation (multiple spaces vs single space, trailing newlines) -> same digest because normalization collapses whitespace; WHY: whitespace-only differences are not semantically distinct blockers

adversarial.desc: Two reasons whose first 200 chars are identical and whose tails differ by a single trailing space character -> must produce distinct keys after fix; WHY: minimal distinguishing delta ensures the fix does not use a too-coarse comparison window that still truncates

Reason crafted so normalization collapses the tail entirely to # sequences (all content beyond char 200 is digits and absolute paths) -> still distinguishable from a reason whose tail has a different count of # tokens; WHY: normalization must not destroy ALL distinguishing information in the tail

Two reasons that differ only in digits within the first 200 chars (e.g. b-1234 vs b-5678, both normalized to b-#) -> SHOULD still collide (same semantic blocker, only volatile tokens differ); WHY: fix must not over-discriminate by removing normalization -- desirable collisions must be preserved

items.title: Hard-stop after the threshold and name the unmet precondition
items.context: When the counter reaches the threshold (default 3), stop the loop and emit a diagnostic that states the actual unmet precondition rather than a generic refusal, e.g. that findings lack agent attribution and that re-review cannot clear it because attribution is fixed at finding_add time.

happy.desc: assessBreaker({maxGateRepeat:2}, thresholds={maxGateRepeat:2}, priorState={autoRecoveriesSpent:1}) -> action=freeze, reasons array includes string matching gate-repeat; WHY: confirms hard-stop fires when threshold met and recovery budget exhausted

enforceConvergenceBreakerGate on command=story_advance when gate-failure counter >= threshold -> throws Error whose message includes storyId and tripped counter description (gate-repeat N>=T); WHY: diagnostic must name the specific tripped signal so an unattended agent can self-correct, not a generic refused-to-advance

edge.desc: assessBreaker with maxGateRepeat=1 and threshold=2 -> tripped=false, action=proceed; WHY: boundary just below threshold must not trip

assessBreaker with maxGateRepeat=2 and default threshold=2 -> tripped=true because comparison is >= (inclusive at threshold per user stated discipline: same reason twice = livelock); WHY: >= boundary correctness

LATTICE_CONVERGENCE_MAX_GATE_REPEAT env set to 0 -> envNumber rejects 0 (allowZero not set for maxGateRepeat), falls back to default 2; WHY: env misconfiguration setting threshold to 0 must not disable the breaker

adversarial.desc: assessBreaker with maxGateRepeat=threshold but priorState.autoRecoveriesSpent=0 -> action=auto-recover (NOT freeze), advance PROCEEDS; attacker gets threshold more attempts in the fresh window before actual freeze; WHY: auto-recovery effectively doubles the runway -- a real loop needs 2 x threshold identical repetitions before hard-stop

LATTICE_CONVERGENCE_MAX_GATE_REPEAT set to 100000 (at CONVERGENCE_ENV_MAX sanity ceiling) -> accepted by envNumber as valid, breaker effectively disabled requiring 100K repeats before trip; WHY: sanity ceiling is permissive enough to let a determined operator neutralize the safety brake via env alone

Malformed priorState JSON with frozen set to string yes (not boolean true), autoRecoveriesSpent=NaN -> normalizeState coerces frozen to false (=== true fails for string) and recoveries to 0 via num(); WHY: type coercion in persisted state means an attacker who writes frozen as a truthy-but-non-boolean value bypasses the freeze check

items.title: Keep the breaker fail-closed and non-forging
items.context: Prove by test that tripping the breaker never marks the gate satisfied, never rewrites finding attribution, and never advances the phase. The breaker only stops and reports; review independence must remain intact.

items.title: Smoke coverage for fire, no-fire and reset
items.context: Cover three cases: breaker fires at the threshold on identical repeated blocks; breaker does NOT fire when the block reason changes between attempts; counter resets after the gate passes. Register the smoke in the validate command set.
